name: Red Pseudanthium
desc: Grass with a beautiful red color. It looks like a flower when seen from far away, but looking closely reveals it to be an intertwined bundle of grass.

eff.name: Synthesis: Quality Up
eff.desc1: Using this as an ingredient for synthesis increases the synthesized item's quality by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - 2nd Stratum
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a slot on the line second closest to the Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
